cases.name: materialized-scalar-subqueries
statements: CREATE TABLE hex_scalar_probe(id INT PRIMARY KEY,n DOUBLE)
SELECT HEX((SELECT MAX(n) FROM hex_scalar_probe WHERE id=1)) AS grouped
SELECT HEX((SELECT n FROM hex_scalar_probe WHERE id=1 UNION SELECT n FROM hex_scalar_probe WHERE 0)) AS unioned
SELECT HEX((SELECT n FROM (SELECT n FROM hex_scalar_probe WHERE id=1) AS source)) AS derived
SELECT HEX((SELECT n FROM hex_scalar_probe WHERE id=1 HAVING n>0)) AS filtered
SELECT HEX((SELECT n FROM hex_scalar_probe WHERE id=2 GROUP BY n)) AS negative_grouped

cases.name: mixed-scalar-subquery-type
statements: CREATE TABLE hex_mixed_probe(id INT PRIMARY KEY,n DOUBLE)
SELECT HEX((SELECT IF(id=1,n,'x') FROM hex_mixed_probe WHERE id=1)) AS mixed
SELECT HEX((SELECT CASE WHEN id=1 THEN n ELSE 0 END FROM hex_mixed_probe WHERE id=1)) AS conditional
SELECT HEX((SELECT COALESCE(n,0) FROM hex_mixed_probe WHERE id=1)) AS coalesced
SELECT HEX((WITH q AS (SELECT n FROM hex_mixed_probe WHERE id=1) SELECT n FROM q)) AS cte
SELECT HEX((SELECT DISTINCT n FROM hex_mixed_probe WHERE id=1)) AS distinct_value
SELECT HEX((SELECT n FROM hex_mixed_probe WHERE id=1 UNION ALL SELECT n FROM hex_mixed_probe WHERE 0)) AS union_all_value
SELECT HEX((SELECT MIN(n) OVER () FROM hex_mixed_probe WHERE id=1 LIMIT 1)) AS window_value
